items.core_financial_extraction_note: Q1/2025 đã được kiểm tra trực quan từ PDF gốc VietstockFinance. Thuyết minh PDF page 19 (printed page 17) ghi công ty không có công ty con nên phạm vi báo cáo là riêng lẻ. B01 tổng tài sản/nợ/vốn và tổng phụ khớp. B02 Q1 current column: doanh thu 850,928,963,332; LNTT 355,107,020,678; thuế hiện hành 72,883,103,138, thuế hoãn lại -12,643,864,866, tổng thuế60,239,238,272; LNST294,867,782,406. B03 Q1 CFO/CFI/CFF/net cash and opening/closing cash bridge all exact. PDF page15 onwards is separate customer brokerage/trust cashflow, not company cashflow.
items.financial_line_items_note: Đã kiểm tra trực quan B01/B02/B03 và thuyết minh trang 17 trên PDF VietstockFinance Q1/2025. Sửa AFS assets OCR từ 8 triệu lên 7,523,915 triệu VND; income_tax tổng từ current-tax-only72,883 triệu lên total60,239 triệu (current 72,883 + deferred -12,644). Sửa PAT OCR candidate275,703 triệu thành294,868 triệu. B03 CFI row70 = -9,337,876,940, including capex -9,339,066,940 and proceeds +1,190,000. Customer cashflows on page15 excluded. All raw VND bridges exact.
items.verification_status_note: B01/B02/B03 and notes visually checked against original VietstockFinance Q1/2025 PDF; separate scope confirmed; all raw VND reconciliation checks equal zero.
items.cash_beginning_calculation: Source B03 line 101, current financial year opening cash; Q1 opening cash equals FY opening.
items.roa_calculation: Q1 PAT / average Q4/2024 closing and Q1/2025 closing total assets × 4 × 100.
items.roe_calculation: Q1 PAT / average Q4/2024 closing and Q1/2025 closing equity × 4 × 100.

ratio_calculation.formula: Q1 PAT / average Q4/2024 and Q1/2025 closing balances × 4 × 100

findings: PDF page 19 (printed page17) states no subsidiaries; separate scope is confirmed.
B01 total assets=liabilities+equity and current/non-current subtotals exact at raw VND.
B02 revenue components, expense components, financial income and expense, operating result, other result, PBT, current/deferred tax and PAT reconcile exactly.
B03 current Q1 is also YTD Q1. CFO+CFI+CFF equals net cash change; opening cash+net change=closing cash exactly.
B03 investing flow line70 is -9,337,876,940 VND, comprising capex -9,339,066,940 and proceeds +1,190,000.
PDF page15 begins separate customer brokerage/trust cashflow statement; excluded from company cashflows.
